problem_text:
A municipality aims to develop a strategy for reducing nutrient runoff from several agricultural fields into a nearby watershed. Initially, no mitigation practices are in place.

The characteristics of each field are as follows:
* For Field 1, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 1.379, and the cultivated area is 212.363.
* For Field 2, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 1.653, and the cultivated area is 248.108.
* For Field 3, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 0.927, and the cultivated area is 183.186.
* For Field 4, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.42, and the cultivated area is 150.204.
* For Field 5, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.011, and the cultivated area is 153.36.
* For Field 6, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 0.818, and the cultivated area is 205.219.
* For Field 7, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 0.757, and the cultivated area is 186.987.
* For Field 8, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.544, and the cultivated area is 293.473.
* For Field 9, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 2.492, and the cultivated area is 145.954.
* For Field 10, the nutrient leaching coefficient is 1.315, and the cultivated area is 135.179.

To mitigate runoff, several best management practices (BMPs) are available, each with a specific effectiveness rate:
* Implementing Practice1 reduces nutrient loss by 25%.
* Implementing Practice2 reduces nutrient loss by 43%.
* Implementing Practice3 reduces nutrient loss by 27%.
* Implementing Practice4 reduces nutrient loss by 55%.
* Implementing Practice5 reduces nutrient loss by 27%.
* Implementing Practice6 reduces nutrient loss by 46%.
* Implementing Practice7 reduces nutrient loss by 71%.
* Implementing Practice8 reduces nutrient loss by 37%.
* Implementing Practice9 reduces nutrient loss by 84%.
* Implementing Practice10 reduces nutrient loss by 16%.

Adopting a practice on a field incurs an implementation cost per unit of cultivated area. The cost matrix for all field–practice combinations is detailed below:

| Field \ Practice | Practice1 | Practice2 | Practice3 | Practice4 | Practice5 | Practice6 | Practice7 | Practice8 | Practice9 | Practice10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field 1 | 119.096 | 102.46 | 122.511 | 97.953 | 115.467 | 166.184 | 43.473 | 191.618 | 23.225 | 30.661 |
| Field 2 | 164.673 | 156.555 | 81.993 | 103.916 | 135.431 | 27.201 | 165.236 | 178.58 | 181.619 | 130.865 |
| Field 3 | 10.035 | 37.878 | 38.351 | 110.939 | 84.097 | 119.807 | 47.177 | 139.488 | 70.154 | 118.353 |
| Field 4 | 183.509 | 67.865 | 189.233 | 92.598 | 196.69 | 75.41 | 26.965 | 11.543 | 197.42 | 86.798 |
| Field 5 | 34.236 | 65.895 | 80.152 | 114.288 | 20.094 | 143.637 | 165.943 | 78.256 | 173.637 | 174.479 |
| Field 6 | 54.696 | 143.422 | 84.911 | 70.444 | 82.73 | 82.497 | 113.573 | 135.873 | 100.226 | 45.763 |
| Field 7 | 83.073 | 185.652 | 169.593 | 39.311 | 199.517 | 137.313 | 35.513 | 23.632 | 12.984 | 147.054 |
| Field 8 | 102.473 | 92.98 | 198.141 | 26.086 | 132.026 | 89.013 | 96.645 | 159.896 | 124.842 | 90.884 |
| Field 9 | 44.162 | 106.789 | 114.89 | 95.509 | 77.508 | 45.3 | 124.869 | 119.808 | 170.893 | 54.982 |
| Field 10 | 105.328 | 88.059 | 113.772 | 79.724 | 195.864 | 117.948 | 143.928 | 31.501 | 101.491 | 141.194 |

The planning authority must decide which practices to implement on each field (fields may adopt multiple practices concurrently), and a field may also remain partially untreated if required.
The objective is to ensure the total nutrient load is reduced by at least a proportion P = 0.271 of the baseline load, while minimizing the total implementation expenditure.
